notes: If name is omitted, a random human-readable name is generated automatically
The worktree name will be used as the branch name
Gitignored files matching .worktreeinclude at the checkout root are copied into the new worktree
.worktreeinclude and --copy-file use gitignore syntax. A file is copied only when it matches and is gitignored, so tracked files are never duplicated
Files that already exist in the new worktree are left unchanged
Symlinks are skipped and are not followed. A .worktreeinclude symlink is not read
.mabo.toml is read from the source checkout, the checkout where the command runs. [hooks] post-create commands run in the new worktree, in order, and stop at the first failure

post-create hooks run only after the repository is trusted. On a terminal, mabo shows the project path and the hook commands and asks 'Trust this project and run its hooks? [y/N]'. No, a non-terminal, stdin or stderr not being a terminal, CI or MABO_AGENT_ID being set, or --json fails before creating the worktree. An empty value counts as unset. Run mabo trust --yes or pass --no-hooks. MABO_TRUST_ALL=1 trusts every repository for that process and writes nothing
--exec receives MABO=1, MABO_NAME (the worktree name), and MABO_PATH (the absolute worktree path). Post-create hooks also receive MABO_ROOT_PATH (the source checkout path)
--json writes the worktree object, copyFiles, and postCreate outcome to stdout. The schema is documented in the README

New worktrees are created under $XDG_DATA_HOME/maboroshi/worktrees/<checkout>-<hash> (default ~/.local/share/maboroshi/worktrees/...). <checkout> is the canonical main checkout directory name, so a symlink uses the same directory. <hash> is the first 8 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the canonical Git common directory. A relative XDG_DATA_HOME is ignored. worktrees-directory overrides this and is joined to the repository root
Owner, purpose, and links are stored in maboroshi/worktrees.json under the Git common directory. --owner overrides MABO_AGENT_ID. Omit both to leave the owner empty. where and exec refresh lastUsedAt

options.name: project
options.description: Repository to operate on instead of the current directory. It may appear with the other options. options.name: json

examples.description: Delete a worktree
Delete multiple worktrees in one command
Force delete a worktree with uncommitted changes
Delete the current worktree

notes: By default, deletion will fail if the worktree has uncommitted changes

By default, deletion will fail if the branch has commits that are not on the default branch or any remote, or if that check cannot be completed. --keep-branch still deletes the worktree and leaves the branch
Deleting the worktree that contains the current directory requires --current or --force

.mabo.toml is read from the source checkout, the checkout where the command runs. [hooks] pre-delete commands run in the worktree before it is removed, in order, and stop at the first failure
Pre-delete hooks receive MABO=1, MABO_NAME (the worktree name), MABO_PATH (the absolute worktree path), and MABO_ROOT_PATH (the source checkout path)

pre-delete hooks run only after the repository is trusted. On a terminal, mabo asks 'Trust this project and run its hooks? [y/N]'. No, a non-terminal, stdin or stderr not being a terminal, CI or MABO_AGENT_ID being set, or --json fails before deleting. An empty value counts as unset. Run mabo trust --yes or pass --no-hooks. MABO_TRUST_ALL=1 trusts every repository for that process and writes nothing

delete removes a linked worktree inside the resolved worktrees directory, or one recorded in maboroshi/worktrees.json. An unrecorded worktree outside that directory is refused. Parent directories are removed only when the worktree is inside the resolved directory
--json reports each deleted worktree, whether its branch was deleted, and per-item errors. The schema is documented in the README

gc.name: gc

options.name: project
options.description: Repository to operate on instead of the current directory. It may appear with the other options. A value starting with /, ., or ~ is a directory inside the repository, including a linked worktree, and resolves to the main checkout. Any other value matches a known project's canonical host/owner/repo name, the directory name from project list, or an unambiguous suffix such as owner/repo or repo

options.name: apply
options.description: Remove the worktrees the dry run would remove. Without --apply or --force, gc only prints the plan

options.name: force
options.description: Remove matching worktrees even when they are dirty or have unpushed commits. Implies --apply. Does not remove the current worktree, a locked worktree, or another agent's worktree that matched only on age

options.name: merged
options.description: Select worktrees whose branch is contained in the default branch. With no criterion flag, merged, closed pull requests, and orphaned worktrees are all selected

options.name: pr
options.description: Select worktrees whose linked pull request is closed or merged. gh is queried when it is available. A missing gh does not fail the command and does not select the worktree

options.name: orphaned
options.description: Select worktrees whose directory is missing, whose git registration is prunable, or whose branch ref is gone. A metadata record whose directory is already gone is dropped without deleting a directory git does not list

options.name: older-than
options.description: Select worktrees last used, or created when never used, at least this long ago. The value is a positive integer plus m (minutes), h, d, or w, such as 14d. Age alone does not remove another agent's worktree

options.name: owner
options.description: Only consider worktrees recorded for this owner. Unowned worktrees are excluded

options.name: keep-branch
options.description: Remove the worktree but keep its branch. Also implied by the keep-branch preference

options.name: no-hooks
options.description: Remove matching worktrees without running pre-delete hooks. This does not trust the repository. gc never asks for trust

options.name: json
options.description: Print a versioned JSON object to stdout. Errors are JSON on stdout. Hook output goes to stderr

examples.description: Show what would be removed
Remove merged, closed, and orphaned worktrees
Remove worktrees that have not been used for 14 days
Remove one agent's stale worktrees, including dirty ones

notes: gc is a dry run until --apply or --force. A second apply removes nothing
gc selects linked worktrees inside the resolved worktrees directory and worktrees recorded in maboroshi/worktrees.json. An unrecorded worktree outside that directory is ignored

The current worktree, the primary checkout, and any worktree checked out on the default branch are never removed. The default branch is origin/HEAD when that ref exists, otherwise main, otherwise master
A branch that still points at the commit it was created from is not merged. It can still match --older-than or --orphaned

A stored pull request URL is passed to gh pr view. A number with no URL is checked only when gh can name the current repository. When gh is missing or cannot answer, gc reports that the pull request status is unavailable
Another agent's worktree is removed only when it is merged, its pull request is closed or merged, it is orphaned, or --owner names that agent
Dirty worktrees and worktrees with commits that are not on the default branch or a remote are skipped unless --force
Live removals run [hooks] pre-delete from .mabo.toml and then the same deletion as mabo delete. A hook failure skips that worktree and continues

gc never asks for trust. An untrusted repository with pre-delete hooks is skipped, and the detail is 'untrusted hooks'. --no-hooks removes those worktrees without running hooks. MABO_TRUST_ALL=1 trusts every repository for that process
--json lists each candidate, why it matched, and the action taken. The schema is documented in the README

Deleting the checkout and cloning it again at the same path keeps the record. mabo untrust clears it. Changing hook commands does not ask again
The file is $XDG_STATE_HOME/maboroshi/trust.toml when XDG_STATE_HOME is an absolute path, otherwise ~/.local/state/maboroshi/trust.toml. Each entry has path and trustedAt

mabo trust shows the post-create and pre-delete commands from the checkout you name, then asks 'Trust this project? [y/N]'. It does not ask when CI or MABO_AGENT_ID is set, or when stdin or stderr is not a terminal. Use --yes then. A repository with no hooks can still be trusted
MABO_TRUST_ALL=1 treats every repository as trusted for that process and does not write trust.toml. Set it to the single character 1. This is for CI and containers

notes: Subcommands:
get <key>    Show a preference value
set <key>    Set a preference value
remove <key> Remove a preference value
Preferences are stored in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/maboroshi/config.toml (default ~/.config/maboroshi/config.toml).
The file and directory are created on the first set. Comments and formatting are preserved.
Supported keys:
worktrees-directory - path relative to the Git repo root for storing worktrees (default is $XDG_DATA_HOME/maboroshi/worktrees/<checkout>-<hash>, or ~/.local/share/maboroshi/worktrees/...)
directory-name-separator - replaces '/' in worktree directory names only (defaults to / for nested directories)
keep-branch - keeps the branch when deleting a worktree (defaults to false)
ghq-discovery - discovers ghq-managed repositories as projects (defaults to true)
root - absolute path, or ~/path, where mabo clone places repositories (defaults to the first git config ghq.root, then $GHQ_ROOT, then ~/ghq)

clone.name: clone
clone.description: Clone a Git repository into the ghq-compatible layout and register it

options.name: branch
options.description: Branch to check out when the repository is cloned

options.name: depth
options.description: Create a shallow clone with this many commits. Must be a positive integer

options.name: update
options.description: Fetch origin when the repository already exists at the destination

options.name: json
options.description: Print a versioned JSON object to stdout. Git progress goes to stderr. Errors use the version 1 error object

examples.description: Clone owner/repo from github.com
Clone an SSH URL and check out a branch
Shallow clone and print the versioned JSON result
Fetch an existing checkout and register it

notes: owner/repo uses github.com. host/owner/repo uses that host.
https URLs, http URLs, ssh:// URLs, and scp-style git@host:owner/repo paths are accepted. A trailing .git suffix is optional.
The repository is placed at <root>/<host>/<owner>/<repo>. The host is lowercased, and a URL port is part of that directory (example.net:9443).

The root is the root key in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/maboroshi/config.toml, otherwise the first git config ghq.root value, otherwise $GHQ_ROOT, otherwise ~/ghq. A configured root is used without reading git config. A git config read failure warns and falls through to $GHQ_ROOT or ~/ghq.
When that path is already the same repository root, mabo registers it and prints the path instead of cloning again. --update fetches origin in that case.
remoteUrl omits http and https userinfo, including a token used as the username. ssh and scp-style URLs keep the login name. file:// URLs and absolute scp-style paths are rejected.
--branch and --depth apply only when cloning. updated is true only when an existing repository was fetched.
If the path exists but is not that repository, the command exits with a validation error.
The project is always registered. New worktrees for that repository are created under $XDG_DATA_HOME/maboroshi/worktrees/<checkout>-<hash> unless worktrees-directory is set.
Authentication is left to Git. mabo does not call gh.
Git progress is written to stderr. With --json, stdout is only the version 1 result: path, host, owner, repo, remoteUrl, cloned, and updated.

options.name: project
options.description: Repository to operate on instead of the current directory. It may appear with the other options. A value starting with /, ., or ~ is a directory inside the repository, including a linked worktree, and resolves to the main checkout. Any other value matches a known project's canonical host/owner/repo name, the directory name from project list, or an unambiguous suffix such as owner/repo or repo

options.name: base
options.description: Base branch for new issue branches (issues only, default: repository HEAD)

options.name: owner
options.description: Who created the worktree. When omitted, MABO_AGENT_ID is used if that environment variable is set

options.name: purpose
options.description: Free-text description of the task this worktree is for

options.name: no-hooks
options.description: Check out the pull request or issue without running post-create hooks. This does not trust the repository

options.name: json
options.description: Print a versioned JSON object to stdout, including the worktree and PR or issue info. Errors are JSON on stdout. Hook output goes to stderr
